description: If a relation assigns exactly one set y to every x in a set A, there is a set consisting exactly of those outputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AxiomaticSetTheory.replacement_unique_outputs.{u} (A : ZFSet.{u})
  (R : ZFSet.{u} → ZFSet.{u} → Prop) (hR : ∀ x ∈ A, ∃! y, R x y) : ∃ B, ∀ (y : ZFSet.{u}), y ∈ B ↔ ∃ x ∈ A, R x y
